description: Manage server-side email rules that auto-process incoming messages (move, tag, mark read, delete).

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

actions.description: Actions on match: { move_to?, mark_read?, delete?, add_tags? }

conditions.description: Match conditions: { from_contains?, subject_contains?, subject_regex?, to_contains?, has_attachment? }

priority.description: Higher priority rules match first (for create)

name: manage_rules
